task: SEC-1 regression test for torch.load weights_only latent-pth RCE fix (fix itself already landed); BP-2 ffmpeg subprocess.run timeout on voxtral/audio_ops conversion paths

plugins/tts_xtts/tests/test_sec1_latent_.summary: New regression test locking in the SEC-1 fix (torch.load(..., weights_only=True) at the 4 latent .pth load sites in xtts_inference.py). Crafts a real malicious pickle (subprocess.run via __reduce__) and proves weights_only=True blocks it while weights_only=False would have executed it; also proves a legitimate {gpt_cond_latent, speaker_embedding} latent.pth still loads; grep-guards that no weights_only=False sink remains under plugins/tts_xtts/plugin/.

plugins/tts_xtts/plugin/core/xtts_infere.summary: No new edits this task — the 4 torch.load(..., weights_only=True) sites (serve-mode _get_latents ~514/535, one-shot get_latents ~679/686) were already fixed on disk (uncommitted) before this task started; this task only added the regression test above.

plugins/tts_voxtral/plugin/core/implemen.summary: _convert_to_wav now passes timeout=300 to subprocess.run and catches subprocess.TimeoutExpired, re-raising as VoxtralError('Audio conversion timed out after Ns (ffmpeg may be stuck).') instead of letting a wedged ffmpeg hang the caller (BP-2). Propagates uncaught through voxtral_generate's per-payload try/except (which only guards the httpx/VoxtralError branch, not the conversion branch), so callers see a clean VoxtralError rather than an unhandled TimeoutExpired.

plugins/tts_voxtral/tests/test_voxtral_i.summary: Added test_convert_to_wav_surfaces_clean_error_on_timeout, test_convert_to_wav_passes_timeout, and test_voxtral_generate_surfaces_clean_error_when_conversion_times_out covering the BP-2 fix and its end-to-end propagation.

app/engines/audio_ops.py.summary: convert_to_wav now passes timeout=300 to subprocess.run and catches subprocess.TimeoutExpired, logging a warning and returning rc=1 (matching this function's existing -> int failure-signal contract) instead of letting an unhandled TimeoutExpired propagate (BP-2). No in-repo caller currently exists for this export; fix is defensive.

tests/engines/test_engines.py.summary: Added test_convert_to_wav_passes_timeout and test_convert_to_wav_surfaces_clean_error_on_timeout covering the BP-2 fix in app/engines/audio_ops.py.
